PODCAST AUDITIONS — read this before running.

SETUP: create the folder ~Pictures/PodcastAuditions/anchors/ before the first run. Nothing in the pipeline creates directories, and loopSave is handed a full path.

Keep that folder EMPTY except for what this project writes. loopLoad indexes the directory by sorted position, so any stray image — a thumbnail, an old export — repairs every anchor with the wrong character.

RUN ORDER: phase A writes the six anchors, phase B reads them back as first frames. Run the whole project in one pass. In Tanque Studio it must be one pass — loop paths there resolve against the run's own timestamped output folder, so anchors from an earlier run are invisible to a later one.

FIRST TIME: set both loop counts to 1 and run phase A alone. That proves the folder exists and that the canvas save lands, in a fraction of the time a full run takes.

TRIM: to keep the characters and skip the auditions, delete the marked note below and everything after it.

blurry, low resolution, jpeg artifacts, watermark, on-screen text, subtitles, warped face, malformed hands, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, camera shake, handheld wobble, zoom, dolly move, rack focus, cut to another shot
A casting-room headshot, medium shot, of
